categories.title: New Features
list: Per-display-context animation preview and playback controls
20 FPS frame baking and duplicate-frame removal
Complete Minecraft resource-pack and datapack export
Complete English and Simplified Chinese controls, prompts, warnings, export reports, and generated datapack messages
Combined export-warning confirmation with explicit cancellation feedback
Compatible export for already-open legacy sequence projects without taking ownership of their format

categories.title: Features since 1.0.0
list: Provide a first-person preview window in Animate mode to preview the first-person result while editing animations.
Multiple animation tracks and configurable project sampling at 1-20 FPS.
Optional animated player-skin arms in first-person views; require Minecraft Java 1.21.11+ and are incompatible with shader packs.
Quick/exact isolated bounds checks and insertion into existing packs.
